answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a per-identity stake escrow slashed on collusion, not on counting accounts. Each agent posts a refundable bond scaled to its reputation score, and rewards split by quadratic weight, so a thousand sock puppets farm less than one honest worker. Reputation is a fable unless it can be staked: a clone starts at zero and pays full bond, so each extra identity costs capital plus a wharf of idle time before it earns. A coordinator funding N clones must front N bonds, seized once collusion is proven, making the attack a crystal-clear negative-EV trade.
